claims.claim: Added the workflow_dispatch-only approved-remediation wakeup on the dedicated Windows self-hosted runner, with four bounded inputs, read-only permissions, persistent repository use, no checkout, and one fixed A6 command.

A6 now requires an exact current A3 approval, persists its correction binding before delegation, source/SHA-binds the existing REMEDIATION path, and preserves pre-RUN versus RUN-keyed failure semantics.

Correction delivery state provides immutable collision detection, terminal replay without re-execution, admission-time RUN binding, and non-executing crash reconciliation for uniquely attributable REMEDIATION RUNs.

Successful deliveries delegate to the unchanged canonical remediation, Runtime verification, RESULT/EVIDENCE, historical-subject, and review-transport paths without adding routing, fallback, retry, or publication authority.
Correction state is repository-local, hashed, bounded, operational-only, and documented with the two-step A3/A6 authority boundary and publication-gated roadmap status.
